title: AI must serve humans, rather than 'become an instrument of domination and injustice', pope warns
content: Pope Leo XIV, who has made AI a central component of his pontificate, warned against the dangers of the technology at  UNESCO.

title: Emmanuel Macron and Pope Leo XIV set out clashing world views at first meeting in France
content: Speaking at the Elysée, the pontiff set the tone for his first visit to France; dialogue with the Republic, warnings over AI and a call for peace, while acknowledging ongoing disagreements.

title: Watch: Pope Leo XIV warns AI could threaten humanity in ‘paradise of machines’
content: Pope Leo XIV has warned against losing humanity in a “paradise of machines” as artificial intelligence increasingly shapes daily life. During his first papal visit to France, he called for greater ethical discernment and for keeping human beings at the centre of AI discussions.

title: Small businesses in rural France bears the brunt of energy crisis triggered by Iran war
content: In the Oise department, soaring energy prices driven by the war in Iran are hitting rural businesses hard, as they face rocketing bills for heating oil and diesel.

title: From Croatia without waste: “truly circular” process offers hazardous chemicals a second life

title: Police clash with protesters in Madrid following forced eviction of 'Maricarmen'

title: Rebalancing of trade with China 'existential' for EU, Commissioner Séjourné tells Euronews
